faqs.a:
The city council has determined that the presence of lead drinking water service lines
               ("LSL") can be an exposure pathway to lead and can pose a health and safety hazard
               to the general public. It is the intent of the city council to prohibit the presence
               of LSL within the city's water service area, and to establish the Lead Service Line
               Replacement Program to provide financing solutions or financial assistance for replacement
               of LSL. The purpose of this article is to comply with updates to the U.S. Environmental
               Protection Agency's Lead and Copper Rule (40 CFR 141 Subpart I), and with updates
               to the Colorado Primary Drinking Water Regulations at 5 C.C.R. 1002-11.
(
Ord. No. 4869
, § 1, 3-4-2024)
